messages:
Priya (Finance): Heads-up: the Q2 experiment promo EXPQ2-PROMO auto-applied to Acme's invoice INV-78329 even though they're on a Dedicated commit. @Liam @Ava can you confirm next steps?
BillingBot: Action logged: promo EXPQ2-PROMO applied to INV-78329 by rule 'experiment-auto' (id: exp-2026-04).
Liam (Sales): Was the rollout global?
Priya (Finance): Yeah, the cohort filter was too broad. We need to reverse on the current invoice and either issue a refund or roll it forward as a credit. CS preference will decide.
Ava (Customer Success): Reached out to Acme. They replied: "Please move the credit to next month's invoice, that's easiest." They want a short confirmation email when done.
Marco (Accounting): OK we can do a manual adjustment. Need finance lead approval and GL mapping.
Priya (Finance): Approved to roll the $1,000 forward as a goodwill credit. Post to GL 5230-promo. Include note: "misapplied by exp-2026-04".
Marco (Accounting): Creating JN-4882. Will post adjustment and link to next invoice INV-78383.
Priya (Finance): Reference invoice snippet:
```
INV-78329 (2026-04-18)
- Hosted API usage: $12,345.67
- Committed discount: -$2,500.00
- Promo (EXPQ2-PROMO): -$1,000.00  <-- misapplied
Total due: $8,845.67
```
BillingBot: Manual adjustment queued by Marco. Status: pending apply on next billing cycle.
Ava (Customer Success): I'll send the customer note: "We've moved the $1,000 EXPQ2 promo to your May invoice (INV-78383) as a goodwill credit; original INV-78329 remains paid as adjusted."
Liam (Sales): Fine. Also flagging experiment owners to tighten rollout guards.
Priya (Finance): Opening ticket for experiments team: EXP-COHORT-623 to restrict rollouts.
Marco (Accounting): Adjustment applied and JN-4882 posted. Attached JN PDF to Acme account.
BillingBot: Adjustment applied; audit note added to INV-78329.
Priya (Finance): Closing loop: rolled forward promo as goodwill, used GL 5230-promo, JN-4882 created, CS notified customer, ticket opened for experiment scope. :white_check_mark:
